hook: Review any app or doc without edit access

beats.say: Remark is a free, open-source app for reviewing anything on your screen, from a friend's app onboarding to design feedback or bug bounty evidence.
Press a shortcut and drag over part of the screen, or highlight text, then type or speak a note and tag it as a bug, UX issue, question or idea.
Every note lands in a local session, and you export one report as PDF, HTML, Markdown, JSON or CSV. It runs on macOS 13 and later, and Windows.
